intent: Make the authenticated SADHANA phone surface mechanically view-only for normal pause and resume requests until the exact preparation pause has been followed by a receipt-bound dispatch activation transition. Preserve the separately deliberate emergency-stop path, and fail closed on missing, malformed, or predispatch control evidence. This UI gate is presentation defense in depth; release-side authority validation remains the owner of actual dispatch and control semantics.

commit.message: fix(dashboard): lock normal controls before dispatch

interface_mismatches: A prepared PAUSED projection is observer bootstrap evidence, not dispatch authorization; normal mobile controls must remain mechanically unavailable before the receipt-bound activation transition.
The preparation pause is the idempotent first authority transition. The release activation must own the unique second transition before this UI may expose pause or resume.
A UI-disabled button is defense in depth only. The control API and root release controller must independently reject requests outside their typed authority state.
honest_blockers: This packet cannot authorize or perform dispatch; it depends on the final release proving an exact sequence-2 activation transition bound to the authenticated phone proof and dispatch marker.
Browser tests prove rendering and request suppression in fixtures, not live Tailscale identity, mobile reachability, API custody, or provider execution.
Emergency stop remains separately deliberate and requires the existing two-step reason plus exact confirmation phrase; it does not become evidence that stop effects executed.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the five exact dashboard files together only after dispatch is stopped. Never compensate for a UI regression by weakening the release controller, control API, authenticated phone proof, or emergency-stop confirmation contract.
